title: CLI resolves ports, paths, proxies and native-binding overrides from the environment
intent: Observed across @tailwindcss/oxide, rolldown, parcel, typescript and astro patch releases: named reads of configuration variables (PORT, HOME, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, NAPI_RS_NATIVE_LIBRARY_PATH, npm_config_https_proxy), directly, split across lines, through a multi-line destructuring, through a `const env = process.env` alias used only for named reads, or through TypeScript's lowering of `process?.env?.NODE_ENV`; writing PATH; presence and type guards; and process.env in comments. None of it reads a secret or hands the environment on, so code.credential-access must stay quiet and the modified file must roll up low.
